value.rationale: FreeTeacher independently acquires clause meanings from raw current units. The planner only performs lexical clause location, then asks the frozen reader reusable semantic questions. Clause-level answers provide precise evidence anchors; separate whole-source audits are the only route to category-absence markers. The composition program emits typed terms solely from definite semantic choices and grounded evidence, preserves affiliate personnel as distinct from the recipient's own employees, retains disposal connectors and triggers, and reports unsupported relevant frames instead of silently dropping them.
